name: filmos-chatgpt
description: Read an explicitly granted FilmOS project through the local read-only MCP boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Read one granted FilmOS project through local MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the loopback FilmOS MCP service with a short-lived Project Grant. It exposes project-scoped read tools and preview-only proposal handoff; approval, lock, apply, delete, paid tasks, upload, and publication remain unavailable.
